strongest_angle: The Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias published a study measuring the exact size and physical extent of the largest known galaxy, IC 1101, using ultra-deep imaging.

key_facts.fact: The Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias published a study on October 2, 2026, measuring the exact size of the galaxy IC 1101.
Carlos Marrero-de la Rosa and colleagues authored the study on IC 1101 published in Astronomy & Astrophysics on October 1, 2026.
Catherine Vialle reported on the press release regarding the IC 1101 galaxy study published on October 2, 2026.
